target_customer: Developers and companies needing utility energy data
problem: Building integrations with hundreds of US utilities to read energy data is slow.

founders.name: Drew Kim
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page lists software engineer. Edmund Tian appears as co-founder on one profile only, not confirmed.

exit.reason: Not public; VCBacked states Pelm is no longer operating.

competitors.name: UtilityAPI
competitors.what: Utility data API for energy and solar
competitors.funding_then: $10M Series A May 2022 (a few months after batch)

competitors.name: Arcadia
competitors.funding_then: $200M round May 2022 (a few months after batch)

technical_complexity.rationale: Scraping and integrating many utility portals reliably is tedious and brittle.

defensibility.rationale: Coverage breadth helps but established aggregators had more coverage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Arcadia raised $200M in 2022 and acquired Urjanet that year.

market_need_then: Climate and energy apps needed bill and usage data; Arcadia and UtilityAPI raised sizable rounds in 2022.

branding.domain_note: pelm.com later redirected to a domain sale page (Atom) when fetched in 2026

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; positioned itself as Plaid for utilities.

outcome_analysis: Pelm built a developer API for utility energy data and took YC W22 money. It appears to have stopped operating; the cause is not public, and larger funded rivals Arcadia and UtilityAPI raised big rounds in 2022. The company domain now redirects to a name sale page.
notes: Funding rests on VCBacked (single database); another listing says $1.5M total unverified. Founder education not found.
